summary: User asked whether delete ticket feature exists for /tickets/545. Confirmed it is already implemented: backend DELETE /tickets/{id} via TicketController::destroy, admin-only via TicketPolicy. UI available on tickets index (dropdown Hapus) and edit page (Hapus Tiket button), but not on the show/detail page which only supports deleting attachments, vendor costs, spareparts, and collaborators.
